lead.claim: Assess pelvic floor function in female CrossFit athletes, especially with high-impact activity.
lead.context: _Why this matters:_ This systematic review found high rates of pelvic floor dysfunction, particularly urinary incontinence, in women practicing CrossFit.

supporting.claim: Consider whole-body electromyostimulation for sarcopenic older women to improve function.
supporting.context: _Why this matters:_ This RCT suggests 8 weeks of whole-body electromyostimulation improved balance, strength, and body composition in sarcopenic older women.

supporting.claim: Youth strength training research lacks focus on long-term outcomes and female athletes.
supporting.context: _Why this matters:_ This scoping review revealed that most youth strength training studies focus on physical performance, not injury prevention or psychosocial factors.
